about: Rallly with its PostHog analytics on (lukevella/rallly 3e63239d, apps/web/src/lib/posthog.ts; posthog-node 5.46.1, the version its packages/posthog pins), on the World-issued project token and personal API key: its server client captures a guest's personless comment, Ada's register with her $set, the guest merged into her and a poll creation, flushes, and reads them back through the events and persons APIs; a second account is erased with Rallly's deletePostHogPerson. Readback after resume reads Ada's person and events without writing.
